location: Instructions for Form 6251 (2025), page 1, “Enhanced deduction for seniors”

en.title: Instructions for Form 6251 (2025) cite 26 U.S.C. §56(b)(5)(D), which does not exist
en.summary: The 2025 Instructions for Form 6251 say the enhanced deduction for seniors is treated as a personal exemption and added back to alternative minimum taxable income “as an adjustment under section 56(b)(5)(D)”. Section 56(b) has no paragraph (5); the disallowance of personal exemptions is in section 56(b)(1)(D).
en.impact: Citation only: the amount added back on the form is not affected.
en.correction: Cite section 56(b)(1)(D), subject to the publisher's confirmation.

quotes.locator: Instructions for Form 6251 (2025), page 1, Enhanced deduction for seniors
quotes.text: The deduction is treated as a personal exemption that is added back to alternative minimum taxable income as an adjustment under section 56(b)(5)(D).

quotes.source: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, 26 U.S.C. §56 (online edition)
quotes.text: The standard deduction under section 63(c), the deduction for personal exemptions under section 151, and the deduction under section 642(b) shall not be allowed.
